text: Testing plays an important role in software development. Unit tests check small parts of code, while integration tests make sure different parts work together correctly. Many developers use test-driven development, which means writing tests before the actual code. This approach helps them think more clearly about what the code should do. Tests also give developers confidence. When they change something, they can run the tests again and quickly see if anything breaks. Without tests, making changes can feel risky and stressful. In short, good testing saves time, reduces bugs, and helps teams build better software.
